import math, json
from fractions import Fraction

r = 6
c = 6
theta = 2 * math.asin(c / (2 * r))          # central angle of the chord
frac = Fraction(theta / math.pi).limit_denominator(1000)   # theta / pi
assert abs(float(frac) * math.pi - theta) < 1e-12

# minor segment = r^2/2 * (theta - sin theta); larger = pi r^2 - minor
pi_coeff = Fraction(r * r) - Fraction(r * r, 2) * frac
tri = r * r * math.sin(theta) / 2           # triangle area = k * sqrt(3)
k = Fraction(tri / math.sqrt(3)).limit_denominator(1000)
assert abs(float(k) * math.sqrt(3) - tri) < 1e-9

larger_numeric = math.pi * r * r - r * r / 2 * (theta - math.sin(theta))
check = float(pi_coeff) * math.pi + float(k) * math.sqrt(3)
assert abs(larger_numeric - check) < 1e-9

final = f"{pi_coeff}\\pi + {k}\\sqrt{{3}}"
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final,
    "evidence": {
        "theta_over_pi": str(frac),
        "pi_coeff": str(pi_coeff),
        "sqrt3_coeff": str(k),
        "numeric": larger_numeric
    }
}))
